status: synthetic methodology development; drug-discovery effectiveness NOT_TESTED

streams.partner_rule: same kind, the other seed (transplant arm)

lifecycle.library_rule: gain>=0.004, wins>losses, wins>=2 (leave-one-background-out replay of fresh Kg1)
lifecycle.plan_rule: gain>=0.004, wins>losses, wins>=1 on the newest batch (4 backgrounds)
lifecycle.rollback: deployed plan must not be worse than the default planner by more than 0.004 on the validation batch

primary_estimand.text: mean later-task shortlist utility of f1_plan with query budget 3, minus the pre-registered reference f1_kg2 (two-step lookahead, same library) with budget 4: does the learned procedure keep reference quality with one fewer assay unit (25 percent)?
primary_estimand.uniqueness: plan minus max(f1_kg2, f1_distill) at the same budget must be >= +0.01 pooled and >= 0 in at least 6 of 8 streams

secondary_resource: process CPU seconds (one thread): shared factor learning + arm-specific learning/validation/distillation + invocation over all 16 task backgrounds; break-even reuse count reported against fresh Kg1 and fresh Kg2

practical_margin.rationale: predecessor margin (commensurable with the closed studies); about 1.3 percent of the mean later-task utility; eight streams cannot resolve it statistically, so it only defines the development decision rule

decision_rule.ADVANCE_TO_POWERED_INDEPENDENT_DESIGN: uniqueness holds at B=3 AND plan minus nobranch and minus xplant >= 0.005 pooled at B=3 AND worst anchor (plan - fresh Kg1) >= -0.01 AND worst stream (plan - fresh Kg1) >= -0.01
decision_rule.CLOSE_NO_PRACTICAL_BENEFIT_OVER_FRESH_ON: plan minus fresh f1_kg1 < 0.01 pooled at both budgets
decision_rule.CLOSE_EXPLAINED_BY_CONVENTIONAL_LOOKAHEA: plan beats fresh Kg1 by >= 0.01 but not the best of Kg2/distillation by >= 0.01 at both budgets

no_labels: no confidence interval, significance test or SUPPORT label is produced from eight streams
api: not used (optional proposer control omitted by design)
